$comment: ADR-S083 O6 web/Android parity stream. Each client's protocol layer (Android SyncRepository, web SyncEngine) turns these logical ops into its own wire batch: android.json and web.json, golden files written and checked by the clients' own unit tests (SyncParityGoldenTest, parity.test.ts). Backend SyncClientParityIT pushes both batches from two devices and asserts identical server state. Placeholders: $name = a client-minted id (fresh per device in the IT), {{actor}}, {{registerId}}, {{productId}}, {{suffix}}, {{counterAccountId}} = per-device values the IT supplies. The close's uncountedAccounts / approval is added by the IT (it depends on the org's tracked tenders).
